name: Galaxy Z Flip 5

images.credit: Vosveteit, CC BY 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Successor: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 6, Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 7 FE

Body.Dimensions: Unfolded: 165.1 mm H, 71.9 mm W, 6.9 mm D, Folded: 85.1 mm H, 71.9 mm W, 15.1 mm D

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 13 with One UI 5.1.1, Current: Android 17 with One UI 9.0
Platform.CPU: Octa-core (1x3.36 GHz Cortex-X3 & 2x2.8 GHz Cortex-A715 & 2x2.8 GHz Cortex-A710 & 3x2.0 GHz Cortex-A510)

Display.Display: 6.7 in, 1080 x 2640 pixels (~426 ppi density), Foldable Dynamic AMOLED 2X, 120Hz refresh rate, HDR10+, 1200 nits (peak)

Cameras.Rear camera: 12 MP, f/1.8, 24mm (wide), 1/1.76", 1.8μm, Dual Pixel PDAF, OIS, Samsung S5K2LD sensor, 12 MP, f/2.2, 123° (ultrawide), 1.12μm, Sony IMX258 sensor, LED flash, HDR, panorama, 4K@30/60fps, 1080p@60/240fps, 720p@960fps, HDR10+
Cameras.Front camera: 10 MP, f/2.2, 26mm (wide), 1.22μm, Samsung S5K3J1 sensor, 4K@30fps, HDR

Battery.Charging: Fast wired charging up to 25W, Fast wireless charging up to 15W, Reverse wireless charging up to 4.5W

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/6, tri-band, Wi-Fi Direct, Bluetooth 5.3, A2DP, LE
